reviewer_role: Personally read all 225 actual source units in order, all 174 complete frozen pre-peer source-target-category-rationale triples, all 59 pre-peer source deferrals and all six complete candidate triples. Independently required one removal and one precise refinement. Personally reread both old triples, the complete corrected retained triple, the new source-only deferral and all necessary context. Verified all 172 other final retained triples unchanged. This is independent peer review, not the author receipt, and claims no original-language or specialist verification.
read_binding_note: All 174 frozen pre-peer complete triples were personally read. The final TSV is exactly that input with the Job 10:3 to Psalms 137:8 row removed and the Job 15:18 to Job 8:8-10 category/rationale changed as required. Both old complete triples and the complete corrected triple were personally reread after revision. The 59 unchanged source-only deferrals were read with complete source text and reasons; the new Job 10:3 deferral was separately read with its full source, reason and context. All six candidate triples remain unchanged and were independently read.
context_recovery_note: An initial attempt to display the entire target-context JSON truncated its middle. It was not credited as a complete reading. All 70 context ranges were subsequently regenerated from the independently pin-verified INDEX and personally read in seven complete, untruncated groups of ten; additional speaker, narrative, candidate and correction context was read separately. No unseen truncated content supplies reading credit.
independent_pin_verification: All 25 used source, retained-target, candidate and context books were freshly fetched into peer-owned raw files and HTTP-header artifacts, then independently checked for exact pinned Git blob hashes, SHA256 and complete cache equality. Author raw fetches were not reused as peer checks. Revalidated every raw and header hash before acceptance.

review_findings.resolved_removal: Job 10:3 preserves Job as the subject of I disown. Its broad handiwork comparison with Psalms 137:8 is removed and the source remains pending at zero credit.
review_findings.resolved_precision: Job 15:18 invokes wise people and fathers but does not expressly say teaching was transmitted from fathers. The precise final comparison states that limitation.
review_findings.source_variants: Job 9:3 is denied hearing; Job 10:16 compares Job himself to the hunted lion; 12:6 retains examination, 12:18 enthroning, and 13:15 persistent pleading. Job 14:14 affirmative future life and its explicitly labelled same-chapter tension with 14:10 remain unharmonized. Job 15:16 and 34:7 preserve different applications of drinking; 16:16 preserves belly; 17:3 does not assign ethnic identities to thieves.
review_findings.speaker_context: Job, the friends, Elihu, the narrator and the Lord remain distinct. A thematic comparison does not establish a friend’s accusation about Job. The mediating-role comparison with 1 Timothy does not identify Job’s unnamed desired mediator.
review_findings.uncredited_candidates: Runner/chatter equivalence, the Job 33:23 mediator identity, Isaiah 22:22 opening/shutting wording, Job 16:5 comfort to friends, the unnamed heavenly witness’s identity, and Job 17:12 moral inversion all remain unretained with zero additional source or pair credit.
review_findings.history: All author retained-row, candidate and case refinements reconstruct exactly from preserved earlier bytes; every original deferral and candidate survives unchanged except the explicitly recorded author refinements and the one peer-added source deferral.

deferred_source_units.reason: This is the narrative introduction to Job's reply; the substantive claims are reviewed in the ensuing units rather than attaching a name-only connection.

The assertion of divine wisdom, might and resistance remains context for the particular cosmic and judicial comparisons that follow; no additional sufficiently distinct counterpart is retained for this general declaration.
The conditional hearing and sifting of Job's words belong to the continuing legal complaint; no additional independent comparison is established for this formulation.
The supplied line says wrath destroys the great and the ruler. A familiar alternative about destroying the blameless and wicked cannot support a target for this actual unit.

The swift-runner comparison does not establish that the separately read lighter-than-chatter image means the same thing. The initial comparison was removed because shared mortal fragility alone was insufficiently particular.
Forgetting while speaking, bowing the face and groaning describe this particular distress; a generic resemblance to other laments does not establish a sufficiently specific separate link.
The sentence joins being ungodly with the question why Job did not die. Its force is retained within his argument without treating it as either a settled confession or a distinct death episode.
The promise to speak without fear concludes the request already compared through 9:34. No additional independent link is assigned to this concluding formulation.

After preserving Job's actual first-person I disown, the connection with a plea that God not neglect His handiwork rests on the shared handiwork phrase. Job questions his own wrongdoing and disowning while the psalm asks God to preserve His works; these distinct actions do not establish a sufficiently particular retained relationship.
The milk and cheese comparison is a particular image of formation. The separately considered womb-formation language does not supply a close counterpart to these specific substances.
Life, mercy and care guarding the spirit remain part of Job's appeal to his maker; no separate particular counterpart beyond the adjacent formation comparisons is retained.
The land of everlasting darkness completes the death-description in 10:21. It is not converted into a mapped location or a comprehensive doctrine of the afterlife.
This introduces Zophar as the Minaean and begins his reply; a shared personal name by itself does not supply a substantive retained comparison.
The command to stop speaking at length continues Zophar's rebuke of many words. A separate generic instruction to be silent would not add a sufficiently distinct link.
The earth's length and sea's breadth extend Zophar's dimensional challenge. No independent particular comparison is retained merely from shared spatial vocabulary.
The wilderness-donkey comparison concerns vain human words. It is not identified with a specific animal passage simply because the animal category recurs.
Confidence, hope and peace after anxiety form part of Zophar's promise. A general promise of peace elsewhere is insufficient to establish a distinct retained comparison for this unit.
This is the reply introduction; it provides speaker context without independent completion credit.
The prepared fall and houses plundered by the lawless are retained as Job's formulation. The prologue's theft of livestock is not turned into a specific report that these houses were plundered.
The earth and fish continue the appeal to creation as teacher. No independent speech episode or identity of a particular fish is established.
God's irreversible demolition and confinement are clear, but the separately read Isaiah candidate does not contain the familiar opening-and-shutting language sometimes supplied to it.
Might, knowledge and understanding repeat the divine-wisdom theme compared at 12:13. No additional distinct counterpart is retained merely to repeat that comparison.

Changing faithful people's lips and knowing elders' understanding are not normalized to a familiar alternative about removing speech or discernment. No precise separate counterpart is established for the actual formulation.
This calls the friends to hear Job's reproof and judgment; a generic command to listen is not treated as an independent connection.

The question about shrinking back and command to become judges are not replaced with a familiar alternative explicitly about showing partiality. The clearer partiality statement at 13:10 is reviewed separately.
The examination and attachment to God lead into the warning in 13:10. No independent additional connection is retained for this conditional setup.
The doubled command to listen introduces Job's declaration and does not independently identify a particular teaching or hearing scene.
The request for two things introduces the conditions specified next; their substantive comparison is retained at 13:21 rather than credited to an unspecified pair here.
The wind-moved leaf and breeze-carried grass express Job's frailty. They are not silently changed into chaff or made to prove that he is the wicked figure of another passage.
The question about bringing this mortal into judgment continues the mortality argument. No separate particular event or defendant is identified beyond that context.
The aged root and trunk dying in rock are conditions in the tree illustration. The adjacent hope and water-dependent growth receive the substantive comparisons.
Erosion of stone and flooded soil illustrate destroyed endurance. A general natural-disaster parallel would not establish a particular event or independently explain this application.
Thrusting the person away and setting the face against him continue the death complaint. No distinct expulsion narrative is securely identified.
Flesh in pain and a mourning soul close the account. Generic bodily suffering alone is insufficient for a further retained link.
This is the introduction to Eliphaz's reply; speaker identification is context rather than a substantive personal-name comparison.
Understanding of spirit and pain of the belly are the supplied words. A familiar formulation about an east wind cannot be imported to manufacture an image parallel.
Eliphaz's accusation of guilt through words and failure to discern rulers' words remains in context. The more precise self-testimony comparison is retained at 15:6.
The question about hearing the Lord's command and receiving wisdom does not itself specify entry to a divine council. That familiar expansion is not credited as an established link.
Eliphaz's questions about Job's daring heart and eyes form the rebuke completed in 15:13; no separately identified deed or visual event is established here.
The instruction to hear Eliphaz's report of what he has seen is rhetorical framing. A generic claim to eyewitness authority does not identify a particular second passage.
The land granted to unnamed ancestral figures and absence of a foreigner do not establish which generation or territorial grant Eliphaz means.
Lifelong anxiety and a ruler's numbered years begin the ungodly-person portrait; no particular ruler is named or independently identified.
The comparison with a general falling in the front rank is figurative. No actual battle or named commander can be inferred from it.
Running against God with a thick-backed shield continues the rebellious figure's attack. No literal military opponent or particular shield episode is identified.
Deserted cities, uninhabited houses and property carried away form a general curse. The text does not identify a particular captured city or land transfer.

The warning against trusting in endurance and the resulting emptiness continues the ungodly person's fate. No separate specific comparison beyond the surrounding plant and property images is retained.
This introduces Job's answer; the substantive response begins in the following unit.
Strength in Job's mouth and not sparing his lips do not explicitly say he would strengthen or comfort his friends. The separately read proposed comparison remains unretained for that reason.
Job weighs speaking and silence against continuing pain. No distinct event or sufficiently particular counterpart is established by speech during distress alone.
Exhaustion, foolishness and decay express Job's state. A generic description of sickness elsewhere does not identify a specific relationship.

The points of eyes, sharp point striking the jaw and collective rush are retained as supplied. A general cheek-blow comparison would omit too much of this distinctive assault description to support a precise separate link here.
Repeated falls and attackers running in strength continue the assault picture. No named attackers or separate battle are established by the metaphor.
Sackcloth on the hide and strength extinguished in earth express mourning and humiliation. Ordinary shared mourning clothing alone is not retained as an additional particular connection.
The heavenly witness and one who knows with Job are not named in this unit. The separately read Christian Advocate candidate does not resolve this witness's personal identity.
Weariness, pleading and the question what Job has done continue the legal lament; no separate specific accusation or offense is identified.
Astonishment among true people and a righteous person's opposition to a lawbreaker do not identify particular observers or a named lawbreaker.
Days passing in a stench and torn joints of the heart remain the actual distress imagery. Neither is replaced by a more familiar wording about plans or purposes.
The shift of night into day and light near darkness does not by itself establish the moral inversion condemned in the separately read Isaiah candidate.
Death as father and decay as mother and sister are personifying kinship images. They do not identify actual relatives or a specific personal genealogy.

The closing question about descending together to Hades or a mound of earth leaves its outcome open. The antecedent of the things descending is not narrowed to a particular possession or doctrine without further support.
